summary: Redact provider management identifiers at the LLM boundary

delivery.outcome: Every OpenRouter failure crossing the LLM boundary preserves actionable status while redacting credential identifiers and provider management URLs
nonGoals: No model, retry, timeout, limit or fallback change
No public contract or schema change
No persistence of raw provider error bodies

architecture.decision: Sanitize provider errors once inside the OpenRouter adapter before any extractor, pipeline or protocol boundary observes them
dataChanges: Failure messages replace credential-shaped values and management URLs with stable redaction markers
architecture.rollback: Revert the adapter redaction and its focused tests; no persisted successful graph depends on the change

validation.evidence: Credential identifiers and management URLs are absent from thrown errors
Non-sensitive provider and invalid-model diagnostics remain unchanged
Host, policy and Docker validation pass
